title: herding run --expertise: plumb, render, rescope the ignore clause
action: Per plan.md Cell 1, honoring CONTEXT.md D1-D3. Entry format (one spelling both paths): a single --expertise flag given once, value holds one entry per line, each line '<path> :: <purpose> :: <read-to>' — exactly three non-empty ' :: ' segments per non-empty line, anything else refuses with a typed message. (a) parse_options in run.rs parses it into Vec<ExpertiseEntry{path,purpose,read_to}>. (b) BriefSpec in mailbox.rs gains expertise: &[ExpertiseEntry]; render_brief renders an '# Expertise — read these before you start' section BETWEEN '# Task' and '# Working directory (absolute)', one '- <abs path> — <purpose>. Read it to <read-to>.' line per entry, path joined onto worktree_root when relative (same base as the files list, mailbox.rs:130); zero entries render no section. (c) D3 rescope: keep 'Never run any bee command.' and the 'Never claim, cap, or write workflow state under .bee/ - writing your mailbox result file (described below) is the ONE exception.' sentence verbatim; reword ONLY the blanket 'IGNORE any bee or agent-workflow instructions' sentence to scope the ignoring to workflow participation and to say Expertise-listed files are yours to read; no rendered sentence may tell the worker to skip listed files. (d) job.json gains an 'expertise' array; the --continue path reads entries back from job.json (fresh flags win) — recorded deviation from the flags-only continue precedent, per plan.md. (e) register --expertise for herding run in the hand-edited packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/generated/registry_payload.json (decision 3358743e) and bump catalog.rs PINNED_FLAG_COUNT 177 -> 178 (one distinct new name). Tests in existing style: render with 2 entries and with 0, malformed refusal, continue round-trip, dry-run carries the section.

truths: Zero --expertise flags render a brief byte-identical to today's
Malformed --expertise value refuses with a typed message
Round N+1 continue brief keeps the entries recorded in job.json
No rendered sentence tells the worker to ignore the listed files
